audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart (Skill x5, Ryze, Skill) disagrees with content win[] and packet (Anivia, Skill, Ryze, Skill, Anivia, Ryze, Ryze) on four rows.
audit.why: Packet and content agree exactly. Level 1 her 1075-range Flash Frost outranges Ryze; level 3 a dodged Q opens the W-root kill; level 6 Glacial Storm plus Rebirth blanks the all-in; two items is Ryze's DPS race.

audit.why: Spikes correct: Anivia 6 (Glacial Storm + egg), Ryze first item and two items. All 4 spikes present.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; Anivia called he/him throughout; Crystallize's 17s wall window and Frostbite's 4s double-damage link were nowhere stated with numbers.
audit.why: Kit file: Flash Frost 11/10/9/8/7, Crystallize 17s, Frostbite 4s (damage doubled only after Q or fully-formed Glacial Storm), Rebirth egg on fatal damage. Ryze has no dash, so the wall traps rather than blocks a dash here.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with real numbers; pronouns fixed across sixteen flagged fields; dos/donts bodies rewritten to their titles using the Q-down 11s window and the stun-answer role of W.

audit.why: Flash Frost's 11s rank-1 downtime is the whole trade window; E never doubles without it.
